headline: Brent Crude Holds Near $92.94/bbl in Orderly Trading
paragraphs: Brent crude edged higher to $92.94/bbl in the latest verified EIA/FRED session (2026-11-17), representing a +0.04% daily change and +3.08% five-session trajectory.

Across broader horizons, Brent stands -22.12% over the past 30 days and +47.15% over the past 52 weeks. U.S. WTI crude settled at $89.53/bbl, keeping the Brent-WTI spread at $3.41/bbl. Recent market headlines point to ongoing trader focus on OPEC+ production discipline, inventory balances, and maritime supply routes.

For Sri Lanka's domestic fuel pricing formula, sustained movements in seaborne crude benchmarks directly influence Singapore Platts refined product assessments, landed CIF import costs, and subsequent monthly CEYPETCO retail tariff reviews.
